memories.summary: As of 2026-06-18, Mara is torn about whether to stay in the ICU or move to a calmer ward, with her answer changing by the hour; she frames it as not yet resolvable.
Mara recognizes she can't sustain working on empty indefinitely, even for work she loves, and treats this as a reason her ICU-vs-ward question stays open.

During the week of 2026-06-18, Halloran (a harsh senior known for brutal debriefs) pulled Mara aside and called her one of the steadiest hands on the unit; she experienced this praise as deeply meaningful coming from her toughest critic.

entities.name: Halloran
entities.description: Harsh senior on Mara's unit who gives brutal debriefs

memories.summary: Mara has long been certain that Halloran respects her despite his harshness, reading respect underneath his brutal debriefs.

entities.name: Halloran

memories.summary: Mara anchors herself with near-term things to look forward to as 'scaffolding' to keep going: a July trip to Lagos, meals at Priya's, and pottery on Thursdays.
